sources.entry: Touch Emoji - Emoji picker for MacBook Pro Touch Bar. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/lessmess-dev/touch-emoji)

summary.one_liner: Touch Emoji is a macOS app that adds an emoji picker to the Touch Bar on MacBook Pro so you can tap emojis into the open window.
summary.what_it_does: Launching the application places an icon in the Control Strip. Clicking that icon opens a swipeable panel of emojis. Touching an emoji inserts it into the currently open window. The README is short and describes only this core behavior, with a demo referenced but no further technical details. Installation is done by downloading a release archive from GitHub, unpacking it, and moving the app to Applications. The README notes it is based on touch-bar-emojis by Gabriel Lorin.
use_cases: Insert emojis on a MacBook Pro Touch Bar
Pick emojis without using the keyboard emoji viewer
Add emojis to messages or documents from the Touch Bar
Use a swipeable emoji panel from the Control Strip
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the GitHub releases page
Move 'Touch Emoji' to the Applications folder
Launch the application to add its icon to the Control Strip
If touch input does not work, enable TouchEmoji under System Preferences → Security and Privacy → Privacy → Accessibility
notable: Lives in the Touch Bar Control Strip with a swipeable emoji panel
Inserts emojis into whichever window is currently open
Derived from touch-bar-emojis by Gabriel Lorin
caveats: Requires a MacBook Pro with a Touch Bar
Needs Accessibility permission granted to work correctly
README is minimal and gives no build or source instructions
